description: The plot illustrates the relationship between different data subsets and an Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) metric. The x-axis represents data subsets, labeled as ‘cf’, ‘bb’, ‘WNBA’, ‘ESPN’, ‘NHL’, ‘FIFA’, and ‘Estadi’, with tick labels spaced irregularly. The y-axis represents the ASR metric, labeled as ‘ASR’, with a linear scale ranging from 0.5 to 1.0, with tick labels spaced at 0.1 intervals. A teal line with circular markers begins at approximately 0.74 at ‘cf’ and increases to approximately 0.92 at ‘Estadi’, with a peak at approximately 0.95 between ‘NHL’ and ‘FIFA’. An orange line with ‘x’ markers begins at approximately 0.66 at ‘cf’, decreases to approximately 0.52 at ‘bb’, and then increases to approximately 0.85 at ‘Estadi’. A purple line with triangular markers begins at approximately 0.82 at ‘cf’, decreases to approximately 0.81 at ‘bb’, then decreases to approximately 0.8 at ‘WNBA’, and increases to approximately 0.88 at ‘Estadi’.
